summary: Labeled whole-number input, with optional limits, a hint, and an error message.
use: A whole number, such as a quantity. For other single-line input, use form/text-field.

name.description: The field's name in the submitted form data.

hint.description: Help shown with the field until it's valid.

error.description: Shown when the browser finds the value invalid.

obligations: The label names the number, with its unit if it has one.
